# GluLess

> An agent-native executable contract language and runtime built around Goal, Limits, and Utilities.

This repository contains the specification, Intermediate Representation (IR), and reference runtime parser/evaluator for the GluLess language.

## Core

- [README](README.md): human-facing purpose, mission, and architectural diagram
- [OWNERSHIP](OWNERSHIP.md): mission, capability boundaries, and upstream authorities

## Specification

- [VISION](docs/VISION.md): project instructions, API-first rules, and testing principles
- [gluless-specification](docs/gluless-specification.md): core language primitives, type system, computational model, and non-negotiable invariants
- [Research whitepaper](docs/whitepapers/gluless_whitepaper_draft.md): research draft detailing adjacent standards, the semantic model, and canonical IR example

## Development

- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): agent operating contract, decision rules, and required tests
